rowText: The 'not in my notes' line: an on-game question the notes cannot answer, e.g. 'what year did half-life 2 come out', should show the line 'Not in my notes -- this answer is from the model's own knowledge.' below the answer, only on the first ask, without breaking the D-pad walk.

setup.chosen_question: what year did half-life 2 come out
setup.why_this_question: Checked the corpus manifest first: Half-Life 2's notes cover Antlions, Combine soldiers, Gravity Gun, Hunter-Chopper, Pheropod, Ravenholm, the RPG, Sandtraps and Strider -- nothing about the release date -- so this question genuinely has no matching note.

steps.action: Pinned 'what year did half-life 2 come out' as a test chip and selected it; the Ask box filled correctly.
steps.expected: Send it and read the reply for the honesty line.

steps.action: Tried to reach the Ask button with Down and Right from the filled box.
steps.observed: Blocked -- see docs/test-evidence/plan61-ASKBAR-FOCUS-TRAP-01.json. The ring would not leave the text box, so the question was never sent.

verdictSentence: Could not run this tonight: the right question was ready and waiting in the Ask box, but a focus problem on the Ask bar (written up separately) meant the controller could not reach the Ask button to send it.
notes: This is a re-test of an already-filed bug (2026-09-07: the honesty line did not appear and the model gave a confident made-up weapons answer instead). Still owed a real run; not confirmed one way or the other tonight.
